Quarto / Rendered Example Artifacts

Rendered example support directories such as examples/*_files/libs/, when present locally, are generated by Quarto or related HTML rendering tools and may include Bootstrap, AnchorJS, clipboard.js, pagedtable, and Quarto runtime assets. These generated directories are ignored by the package build and are not currently tracked as package source, but their in-file notices should be retained if they are ever committed.

Authored R Package Code

The package implementation delegates to and tests against public R packages such as gamlss, gamlss.dist, VineCopula, geepack, lme4, mgcv, and MASS, but those dependencies are not vendored into the package source. Public R package dependencies and optional packages are declared in DESCRIPTION.
